answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vine of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the terrace of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the harbor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
